protocol.k_reward: selected dimension is oracle-informative AND final decision is correct
protocol.scenario: RV-0: uniform categories/actions; centroid-near truth + one/two corrupted dimensions, not uniform [0,1] vectors
protocol.evidence: oracle-informative dimensions restore full value; other reads leave vector unchanged
protocol.pairing: identical pre-generated train/eval cohorts per seed across arms; separate policy RNG
protocol.evaluation: fresh 50 cases each checkpoint; frozen K and counts, exploration retained at evaluation
protocol.starvation: fraction category-dimension pairs with zero TRAIN selections; update starvation separately recorded
protocol.hurts: surface-correct to final-wrong; final totals, all-checkpoint totals, training totals separate
protocol.uncertainty: sample SD; paired seed t-intervals (95%), unadjusted exploratory comparisons
protocol.decisions_to_90pct: first crossing of 90% mean routing at N=400/450/500, includes N=0; proxy not established asymptote
protocol.grulstm: untrained, hand-set RV-0 gates; not trained neural-network baselines
protocol.ucb: Q + c*sigma/sqrt(training_attempts+1), RV-1 definition (no log-time term)
protocol.criterion: lowest c with mean starvation <=.10 and mean routing delta >=-.02
